notes.title: STATIC: Investigator Training is now live on Steam!
notes.notes: A classic FMV title from Ethereal Darkness Interactive, where you will play the role of Julie Masters, a young aspiring investigator who recently requested membership with Berkshire Paranormal. Julie will investigate the Houghton mansion and surrounding areas collecting evidence. Though paranormal events have been documented at the mansion, Julie ends up uncovering an interesting addition to the ghostly history.
